newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Trading at Philippine Stock Exchange halted.
newsitem.headline: Trading at Philippine Stock Exchange halted.

text.p: Trading at the Philippine Stock Exchange was halted about an hour after the session opened on Friday as power supply to the Tektite building housing the bourse was interrupted, an official said.
"The power is likely to be restored by 11 a.m. (0300 GMT)," an official at the bourse's public relations department said.
When trading stopped, the market was in a downtrend with the main index down 38.50 points, or 1.24 percent, at 3,066.27.

The operations department of the Manila Electric Co, which supplies power to Metro Manila, said there was a one to two minute outage of the power circuit within the Tektite area and that power should have been immediately restored.
